verdict.rationale: Terraform CLI is fully scriptable/headless: non-interactive apply via -auto-approve, machine-readable JSON output (-json flag on show, plan, apply), plan files for two-step CI pipelines, and Terraform tests for CI validation — all well documented and widely used in CI/CD pipelines. missing for 10: independent hands-on report of a specific CI pipeline configuration (e.g., GitHub Actions) rather than just docs.
